titles.title: Hill, Stream and Moon

description: A large, beige hill arches over the composition in a rainbow-like shape. Below the hill, a rippling blue stripe between two green banks denotes a stream running across the composition. Bushes dot the upper bank and the top of the hill. A blue and white checkered sky features a yellow moon poking out from above the hill.
title: Hill, Stream and Moon
